default_policy_input.description: Default policy for incoming packets on INPUT chain. Set to 'DROP' for stricter security.

default_policy_output.description: Default policy for outgoing packets on OUTPUT chain. Usually safe as 'ACCEPT'.

default_policy_forward.description: Default policy for forwarded packets on FORWARD chain. Critical for routing/NAT hosts.

log_dropped_packets.description: Enable logging of dropped packets to syslog (requires kernel logging support).

interface_tracking.description: Enable interface tracking —FireHOL automatically assigns interface names to rules based on context.

server_services.description: List of server interfaces and allowed ports/services. Each entry defines a firewall profile for a network interface.

interface.description: Network interface name (e.g., eth0, br0). Must exist on the host.

level.description: FireHOL protection level. 'server' enables port-based filtering; others disable/limit filtering.

client_rules.description: Custom outbound (client) rules to restrict outbound traffic.

description.description: Short description of the rule purpose (for documentation).

lan_networks.description: List of LAN subnets and their trust level to apply specific rules.

interface.description: Interface connected to this LAN (e.g., eth1).

mode.description: 'trusted' allows all traffic from the subnet; 'restricted' requires explicit service rules.

allowed_services.description: List of allowed service names (e.g., 'http', 'ssh', 'tcp/22') — only used if mode='restricted'.

auto_apply.description: Whether to automatically apply firewall rules on service start (recommended for most deployments).
